newsitem.title: USA: American General unit president named CEO.
newsitem.headline: American General unit president named CEO.

text.p: American General Corp said Wednesday it named Joe Kelley, president of its unit, American General Life and Accident Insurance Co, to the additional post of chief executive officer of the unit.
The company also said it named Bill Luther to the newly created post of vice chairman at the Nashville-based unit.
Kelley, 49, joined American General in 1994 as senior vice president and chief marketing officer of American General Life in Houston. He became president of Nashville-based unit in 1995.
Kelley succeeds James D'Agostino Jr, who the company said will be elected president of American General Corp at its annual shareholders' meeting on April 24.
Luther, 54, has been with American General for 33 years, rising to numerous management positions, most recently as senior vice preisdent, insurance administration at American General Life.
